This isn’t your everyday fruit jar… it’s a Hazel Atlas Pineapple and one seriously fun piece of vintage glass.

Originally made as a promotional jam/jelly jar in the 1930s–40s, these little fruit-shaped jars were connected to Kix cereal promotions. And that bold orange glass with its textured pineapple design? Absolutely iconic. 

It’s quirky. It’s colorful. It’s wonderfully vintage. And honestly… how could you not want this rare pineapple on your shelf? 🍍✨
